Underlying NI Rp366.1bn = EBIT Rp726.4bn [F88]; EPS Rp9.00, not Rp112.00. Revenue FY2026E +8.5% (9M Rp5,102.0bn [F28]); gross margin 20.3% (9M 20.28%) to 21.3%, subcontractor cost Rp593.4bn from Rp1,137.8bn [F62, S4]; capex 25% to 19% [S4, S10]; OCF Rp1,456.1bn [F47]. sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown: **Market believes:** Rp220 pays Rp8,591bn against the Rp5,380bn GMR bridge [F19/F90]; ex-GMR EV Rp7,096bn, 1.28x my Rp5,559bn. **Why wrong:** FY2025 profit is a Rp4,535.4bn gain [F18]; 97.67% related-party revenue [F87]; overburden fell 28% [F71-F73]; fees end 2030-31 [F91/F92]. **Proves us wrong:** JORC resource (bull Rp295.4); IUPK extension >120 Mbcm; gross margin >22%.

ADTV Rp193.0bn, mcap Rp8,591bn (2026-10-30); no the liquidity feed key: 5% NAV (Rp756m) is 0.02 days at 20% ADTV. ARA/ARB 25%/15%: Rp59 to Rp8 is a dozen limits. Price Rp220.0.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: Down 86.4%: GMR never produced a resource, the Rp5,380bn appraisal written back; KPC cuts Bengalon volumes as Rp4,575bn refinances higher; renewal refused at 2030-31. Gap risk: exit below Rp8 deepens the loss. Dilution: 18,833.7m at Rp75, 46.29% of capital [F55, F95].

sections.heading: Valuation and EV math
sections.markdown: DCF FY2026E-31E. FY2025 output 138.63 Mbcm, 17.04 Mt [F21/F22]; WACC 13.0%. Operating PV Rp2,268bn. Renewal: per Arutmin's 19-Jan-2026 extension [S3 p.131], at 60% of house TV Rp5,485bn = Rp3,291bn. GMR Rp5,380bn at fair value less DTL [F19/F90]; net debt Rp3,885.3bn [F34/F103/F104] = Rp7,053.8bn, Rp180.6/share. Net debt/trough EBITDA 4.4x (FY2024 Rp874.8bn), 1.8x FY2026E. Complex: coal/commodity NEUTRAL, IDR AVOID; Brent 84 vs 99.18; RKAB 600 Mt [F38].

sections.heading: Entry re-test
sections.markdown: Entry Rp59 is 8.5% below Rp64.5; kill Rp8 < entry Rp59 < target Rp180.6.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
0. **Fact-check.** GMR bridge Rp5,380bn = (F19 6,699.1 - F90 1,305.8) x 99.75% (S5 p.81), correct. Shares 39,049m = F16 - F54 - correct. Net debt Rp3,885.3bn fails [F34/F103/F104]: they sum to Rp3,830.0bn; the Rp55.3bn gap is uncited leases. FY2025 underlying NI Rp366.1bn reconciles neither to its inputs (Rp348.2bn) nor the filing (~Rp293bn ex-F18 pre-tax loss). No fabrication; one unreconciled base year. [MATERIAL]

1. **(a) Not excluded.** The Rp4,535.4bn sits in equity of Rp8,254.8bn (F35, S4 p.11), and the GMR line of Rp5,380bn *is* the bargain gain's cause: the Rp5,854.6bn uplift of appraised value (F19) over consideration (F20). The entry is dropped, its consequence kept. Strip F18 and the Rp591bn treasury over-mark (F67): equity is Rp80/share. Widest error bar is GMR: at consideration NAV is Rp64.5. [MATERIAL]

2. **Variant is a short.** The claimed edge is Rp220 being 18% above base NAV - a short argument filed as a long. The discount is governance and terminal life, correctly priced: 97.67% related-party revenue (F87), a 15.56% Zurich bloc, contracts ending 2030/2031 (F91/F92), 4.4x trough leverage, a commissioner chairing both customers. [MATERIAL]

3. **Catalyst.** catalyst_date null; nothing dated before FY2026 results, and any re-rating needs KPC/Arutmin - which sets the rates - to renew. [MATERIAL]

4. **(b) Wrong archetype.** Operating PV Rp2,268bn vs net debt Rp3,885bn is -Rp41/share; all positive equity is GMR (76% of NAV) plus uncontracted renewal (47%) - an asset-holding/SOTP thesis mislabelled. commodity_capex_turnaround (0.42/75/-35) requires capex DOWN; DEWA's is 25% of revenue, rising (F105). holdco_discount_narrowing (0.33/28/-18) is the right key, demands a NAMED catalyst, and has none. On 0.33 these legs are +11.7% over 3y, under the 11.2% hurdle; quarter-Kelly 1.4%. [FATAL]

5. **Entry unfillable.** Rp59 is below the Rp64.5 GMR-at-consideration value: it prints only where the base case is already broken - and the target then needs a 6.4x re-rating of the appraisal. 59 to 8 at the stated 15% ARB is ~14 limits, not seven; own Kelly 18.2%, not 20.5%. [MATERIAL]

6. **Disconfirming.** S4 p.5: "Lain-lain - bersih 260,203,417" - Rp260.2bn other income, 50.7% of 9M profit; FY2026E Rp423.8bn is below the 9M Rp513.1bn actual, implying an undisclosed Rp89bn Q4 loss. S4 p.4/p.18: E&E of Rp7,040.6bn moved Rp32.0bn in 9M; GMR still "Belum beroperasi". [MATERIAL]

7. **Pre-mortem steelman.** The avoided mode is dilution, not write-down: Feb-2025 issued 18,833.7m shares at Rp75, 46.29% of capital (F55, F95). A failed refinance on Rp4,575bn of ~10% debt repeats it; no dilution scenario or kill. "Lost 30%" also contradicts the model's -86.4%. [MATERIAL]

8. **Pipeline.** stage_log clean: one draft entry 2026-11-06T13:19:44+07:00, identical to estimates_committed_at, ordered, no retro-edited estimates detected; one timestamp covers both - "committed before any market number" is unverifiable, not contradicted. [MINOR]

9. 1 FATAL, 7 MATERIAL, 1 MINOR.

**Verdict: MAJOR_REVISION.** At Rp220 the analyst's own base NAV of Rp180.6 is 18% below the tape, so expected return is negative at every admissible p_up - the long exists only at an entry the thesis concedes is "not a fillable order", which is a short call wearing a long's clothes.

**Stop objecting at Rp78** - 0.7x a NAV that already halves GMR and pays 60% for renewal.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
0. Conceded: cited lines sum Rp3,830.0bn; the Rp55.3bn is lease liabilities, in the house bridge (report §4) — held. FY2025 base year unreconciled (Rp366.1bn vs ~Rp293bn), not in the DCF.
1. Held: NAV is bottom-up, so the Rp4,535.4bn never enters it; Rp5,380bn is appraised net assets less DTL, not the gain. Conceded: equity (Rp80/share) is no anchor; GMR at consideration, renewal kept, is Rp64.5.
2. Conceded: at Rp220 the long is negative; the variant is a short we cannot express. No trade at the tape.
3. Conceded: no dated catalyst; holdco_discount_narrowing requires a named one.
4. FATAL conceded. Operating PV Rp2,268bn - net debt Rp3,885.3bn = -Rp41/share; all positive equity is GMR (76% of NAV) plus uncontracted renewal (47%). Re-keyed to holdco_discount_narrowing (0.33/28/-18); p_up 0.42 to 0.33, bought by this point. Target Rp180.6 and kill Rp8 stay valuation-derived. Renewal Rp3,291bn exceeds contracted PV Rp2,268bn: a 60% weight on uncontracted perpetuity.
5. Conceded: Rp59 is 73% below the Rp220 tape and below the Rp64.5 soft-bear — a watchlist trigger, not an order; Rp59 to Rp8 is over a dozen ARB limits, not seven.
6. Conceded: Rp260.2bn other income is 50.7% of 9M profit; FY2026E Rp423.8bn is below 9M Rp513.1bn, implying a Q4 loss. The DCF runs on contract cash flow; the estimate is flagged, not edited. E&E Rp7,040.6bn moved Rp32.0bn; GMR "Belum beroperasi".
7. Conceded: dilution is the avoided mode — 18,833.7m shares at Rp75, 46.29% of capital [F55, F95]; a failed refinance of Rp4,575bn repeats it. "Lost 30%" was wrong; -86.4% is the model.
8. Conceded minor; nothing retro-edited.
EV at 0.33: 0.33 x (206.1 + 9.3) + 0.67 x (-86.4) - 1.5 = +11.7% over 3y, 3.8%/yr, below the 11.2% hurdle; at Rp220, -61.0%. No trade at any fillable price; watchlist.

sections.heading: Bear re-attack
sections.markdown:
All answered; key fits in form only: one unoperated appraisal (76% of NAV) plus renewal right (47%), the prior's +28/-18 against +206/-86. p_up 0.33 equals the prior, unargued, generous for an -86.4% leg. No-trade stands: the hurdle needs Rp47.8; above Rp66 EV is negative, below Rp64.5 the base breaks. My Rp78 lapses (-15.2%). Pipeline ordered; cut bought by point 4; no level moved; no retro-edit; estimates_committed_at stale; -61.0% is 0.42-era. New: FY2025 gross margin 15.1%, under the 18.0% kill.

KILL_RECOMMENDED. The target, not the entry, is on trial.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
KILL — reason_tag valuation. No fillable price supports a long: at Rp220 the analyst's own base NAV is Rp180.6, a short the book cannot express, with tape EV ≈−69% (the revision's −61% is stale 0.42-era). At the stated Rp59 entry return is +3.8%/yr — below 5.5% INDO cash and the 11.2% hurdle — and Rp59 prints only below the Rp64.5 GMR-at-consideration floor, where the base case breaks; the only hurdle-clearing entry (≈Rp47.8) lies in that same broken zone.

1. Operating PV − net debt = −Rp41/share; all positive NAV is one unoperated appraisal (76%) plus uncontracted renewal (47%).
2. p_up 0.33 equals the prior despite an −86.4% leg vs the prior's −18% — generous, not conservative.
3. Chain clean and revision compliant (p_up cut 0.42→0.33, no level raised, so no new-evidence flag owed); business value, not construction, is the defect.
